name: Antipaladin Calamitous Blackguard
body:
A calamitous blackguard is the harbinger of ruin and apocalypse made flesh in mortal form to reign with supremacy, elevating their allies to a height of destruction they could never otherwise reach.

Auras of Ruination

At 1st level, a calamitous blackguard learns how to project auras that invite calamity and catastrophe.

This ability functions as the marshal’s minor auras (including determining the aura bonus), except as described here. The calamitous blackguard’s effective marshal level for this ability is equal to their antipaladin class levels for all purposes of this ability (including stacking with the marshal class to determine the aura bonus).

Unlike a marshal, all of a calamitous blackguard’s auras of ruination apply either a profane penalty on enemies or a profane bonus on allies (including the calamitous blackguard) as described below. A calamitous blackguard’s effective marshal level is equal to their antipaladin class levels for all purposes of this class feature (including stacking with the marshal class to determine total number of readied auras per day). If an aura of ruination applies a profane penalty on a calamitous blackguard’s enemies, an enemy can suppress the profane penalty on them for one round if they succeed on a Will save DC 10 + 1/2 the calamitous blackguard’s antipaladin class levels + their Charisma modifier at the start of their turn.

All of a calamitous blackguard’s auras of ruination are listed in this section.

Auras of Ruination
Accursed Aim: Affected enemies apply the aura bonus as a profane penalty to their attack rolls made while flanking and on rolls made to confirm critical hits.
Brittle Form: Affected enemies apply the aura bonus as a profane penalty to their Fortitude and Reflex saves.
Confounding Tactics: Affected enemies apply the aura bonus as a profane penalty to damage rolls while flanking or charging.
Dread Bleeding: Affected enemies suffer bleed damage each round equal to the aura bonus at the start of their turn but only as long as they remain within the range of the calamitous blackguard’s auras of ruination. Any effect on an affected enemy that heals hit points damage will automatically suppress the effects of dread bleeding on that enemy for one round.
Dread Fear: Affected enemies reduce their effective HD by an amount equal to the aura bonus for the purposes of determining whether or not they are affected by a fear effect and to determine the DC required to intimidate them.
Fell Opportunity: Affected allies add the aura bonus as a profane bonus to their AC against attacks of opportunity and on their attack rolls made as part of an attack of opportunity.
Laziness: When readied, the calamitous blackguard chooses an ability score and when active, this aura of ruination applies the aura bonus as a profane penalty on all affected enemies to all of their skill checks made with that ability score. This aura may be readied multiple times, choosing a different ability score for each.
Proficiency: Affected allies add the aura bonus to reduce the total nonproficiency penalties for armor and weapons. This cannot reduce the penalty below 0. This bonus may be spread over multiple weapons and armor if applicable.
Profane Aiming: Affected allies add the aura bonus as a profane bonus on their ranged attacks rolls outside of their 1st range increment. This bonus cannot exceed the penalty from range penalties.
Weakened Position: Affected enemies apply the aura bonus as a profane penalty on their Combat Maneuver checks and to their Combat Maneuver Defense.
Weakened Spirit: Affected enemies apply the aura bonus as a profane penalty on their Will saves and concentration checks. This ability replaces smite good gained at 1st, 4th, and 7th levels and aura of cowardice.
Touch of Ruination

At 2nd level, a calamitous blackguard’s research into fallen empires reveals new paths to enable the fall of their enemies and how to feed on the essence of ruination. This ability functions as the antipaladin’s touch of corruption except that it cannot be used to heal undead creatures. Instead, touch of ruination can only heal creatures with the chaotic or evil subtype and the calamitous blackguard themselves. This ability is otherwise identical to and counts as touch of corruption for all purposes (including meeting prerequisites and using the antipaladin’s cruelties). This ability alters touch of corruption.

Exemplar of Ruin and Apocalypse

At 4th level, a calamitous blackguard may now have any two auras active. At 11th level and again at 19th level, the number of auras a calamitous blackguard can have active increases by 1, to a maximum of 4 active auras at 19th level. This ability replaces channel energy, aura of despair, and aura of depravity.

Apocalyptic Auras

At 10th level, a calamitous blackguard discovers the deeper secrets of the essence of ruination. This ability functions as the marshal’s major auras except as described here. A calamitous blackguard’s apocalyptic auras applies either a profane penalty on enemies or a profane bonus on allies as described below. A calamitous blackguard’s effective marshal level is equal to their antipaladin class levels. Unlike the auras of ruination, a profane penalty applied by an apocalyptic aura on the calamitous blackguard’s enemies cannot be suppressed with a Will save.

Apocalyptic Pain

Affected enemies increase the total amount of hit points damage suffered from any source by an amount equal to the aura bonus. This increase in hit points damage suffered is not multiplied on critical hits or affected by any other effect.

Apocalyptic Pressure

Affected enemies apply the aura bonus as a profane increase to the penalty on using weapons or casting spells while underwater and on penalties related to altitude, and they are always treated as flat-footed while climbing or balancing. Abilities or effects that negate these penalties or allows the enemy to not be flat-footed while climbing or balancing functions as normal if the enemy creature is 4+ levels higher than the calamitous blackguard.

Apocalyptic Resistance

When readying this aura, a calamitous blackguard chooses from among acid, cold, electricity, fire, negative energy, or positive energy. This aura provides energy resistance to all affected allies for the chosen energy type equal to five times the aura bonus. This aura may be readied multiple times, choosing a different energy type for each.

Erode Focus

Affected enemies apply the aura bonus as a profane penalty on their caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance.

Greater Confounding Tactics

This aura replaces confounding tactics and applies the aura bonus as a profane penalty to the calamitous blackguard’s enemies on all weapon damage rolls.

Greater Dread Bleeding

This aura replaces dread bleeding. The affected enemies still suffer the same bleed damage as dread bleeding but the bleed damage now persists if the affected enemy leaves the range of this aura. Furthermore, any attempts to heal hit points damage on an affected enemy while within the calamitous blackguard’s apocalyptic auras requires a successful Heal check or caster level check at DC 10 + 1/2 the calamitous blackguard’s antipaladin class levels + the calamitous blackguard’s Charisma modifier.

Lamed Movement

Affected enemies reduce all of their move speeds by a number of feet equal to five times the aura bonus. If this reduces the speed used by an enemy to 10 feet or less, that enemy can only do either a standard action or a move action on their turn as if they were affected by a slow spell.

Profane Protection

Affected allies add the aura bonus as a profane bonus to their Armor Class, including touch Armor Class and when flat footed.

Ruined Weapons

Affected enemies decrease the critical threat range of their weapons by 1/3 (minimum 1) the aura bonus. This does not stack with the decreases provided by any other effects.

Slow Reactions

Affected enemies apply the aura bonus as a profane penalty to their initiative checks. When this aura is readied, the calamitous blackguard may choose to end another aura and activate this aura as a free action when rolling for initiative. This ability replaces smite good gained at 10th level and aura of vengeance.

World of Dread

At 13th level, the range of all of a calamitous blackguard’s auras increases to 100 feet (if applicable). This ability replaces smite good gained at 13th, 16th, and 19th levels.

Avatar of Ruin and Apocalypse

At 20th level, a calamitous blackguard becomes a conduit for the might of ruinous and apocalyptic powers. They gain DR 5/–. Whenever a calamitous blackguard succeeds on a critical hit against any creature, that creature is struck with destructive energies, dealing an additional 1d6 points of damage each from acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, and negative energy (energy resistance and immunity to energy applies as normal). This additional damage is not multiplied on a critical hit. Additionally, whenever the calamitous blackguard uses touch of ruination to harm or inflicts hit points damage with negative energy, they deal the maximum possible amount of damage. This ability replaces unholy champion.
